skill_workbench_review.summary: Cognianalysis is a product harness, not only a report renderer: CLI entrypoints, LLM task workflow, source-tier coverage, skill/detail reviews, readiness contracts, benchmark scripts, docs and fixtures form one analysis product.
skill_workbench_review.scope: Complete inventory with emphasis on src, scripts, benchmarks, docs, resources and representative examples.

findings.title: The product surface is intentionally thin while the workflow remains auditable.
findings.description: The public commands are analyze/status/open/eval and the deeper generated workflow is described as harness-native work under .analysis.

findings.title: Semantic authority belongs to Codex-authored artifacts, with deterministic code validating contracts.
findings.description: The pipeline states Codex authors strategy, source-tier, workbench, detail and final report artifacts; readiness then checks shape, evidence and lineage.

findings.title: Representative fixtures and benchmarks are first-class product proof inputs.
findings.description: Demo, event, fullstack, SOAP and legacy fixtures are connected to golden and baseline/external verification scripts.

outputs_for_later_synthesis.description: Lead the final report with Cognianalysis as a thin CLI harness around Codex-authored source understanding and evidence-backed decision reporting.
Use source families: core harness, report/readiness contracts, verification/benchmarks, docs/skills and representative fixtures.

skill_workbench_review.confidence: high; complete Tier 1 coverage exists and key claims are tied to direct source evidence.
